mcp.title: AI assistants (MCP)
mcp.description: Let Claude, Cursor and other MCP clients read your highlights, books and reading reports. Access is read-only and limited to your own library.
mcp.oauthDescription: Clients that support MCP sign-in (such as Claude) only need the server URL. You approve access in the browser.
mcp.tokenDescription: For clients that take a fixed header, create a token below and send it as a Bearer token.

tokens.title: Access tokens
tokens.description: Each token can read your library until it expires or you revoke it. Treat it like a password.
tokens.emptyDescription: Create one to connect a client that does not support MCP sign-in.
tokens.revokeFailed: Couldn't revoke the token. Try again.

create.title: New access token
create.name: Name
create.failed: Couldn't create the token. Try again.
create.createdDescription: This is the only time it is shown. If you lose it, revoke it and create a new one.

email.title: Import by email
email.description: Email a Kindle notebook export to ClippingKK and its highlights are added to your library. Notes you typed in Kindle are kept under Notes.
email.notConfiguredDescription: This server has no import address configured.
email.stepsTitle: From the Kindle app on iPhone or iPad
email.step1: Open the book and go to its Notebook.
email.step2: Export the notebook and choose to send it by email.
email.step3: Send it to the address above from one of the verified addresses below. Highlights appear within a few minutes.

bindings.title: Your sending addresses
bindings.description: Only mail from these addresses is imported. You can add up to {{max}}, and each one needs the code we email to it.
bindings.emptyDescription: Add the address your Kindle exports are sent from.
bindings.removeDescription: Mail from {{email}} will no longer be imported.
bindings.removeFailed: Couldn’t remove the address. Try again.

add.title: Add a sending address
add.description: We’ll email a 6-digit code to the address to confirm it’s yours.
add.codeDescription: We sent a 6-digit code to {{email}}. It expires in 30 minutes.
add.codeInvalid: Enter the 6 digits from the email.

errors.EMAIL_ALREADY_BOUND: This address is already used by another ClippingKK account.
errors.TOO_MANY_EMAIL_BINDINGS: You can add at most {{max}} addresses. Remove one first.
errors.TOO_MANY_CODES: Too many codes sent. Try again in an hour.
errors.TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS: Too many wrong codes. Send a new one.
errors.CODE_EXPIRED: This code has expired. Send a new one.
errors.INVALID_CODE: That code isn’t right. Check the email and try again.

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Notes you typed in Kindle, imported with your notebook exports.
notes.emptyDescription: When you import a Kindle notebook by email, the notes you typed appear here.

exports.flomoDescription: Post every highlight to your flomo inbox.
exports.notionDescription: Append highlights to a Notion page.
exports.mailDescription: Receive all your highlights as a Markdown file.
exports.queued: Export started. It may take a few minutes.
exports.mailTips: We’ll send every highlight to this address as a Markdown file.

errors.notFlomo: Use your flomo API address, which starts with https://flomoapp.com/.

errors.tokenTooLong: The token can be at most 255 characters.

errors.pageIdTooLong: The page ID can be at most 255 characters.

account.title: Account
account.description: Sign-in, security and your ClippingKK data.
account.gateDescription: Your email, password and connected sign-in accounts are managed in Gate.
account.deleteDescription: Deletes your ClippingKK highlights and profile and cancels ClippingKK subscriptions. Your Gate account and other products stay available.
account.confirmDescription: This permanently deletes your highlights and profile. Type {{name}} to confirm.
account.confirmWordLabel: Type the word above to confirm
account.failed: Deletion could not be scheduled. Please try again.
